steamcmd 完整路径（请先自行安装），Windows 如 C:\\Prog: Full path to steamcmd (install it yourself first). On Windows e.g. C:\Program Files\SteamCMD\steamcmd.exe; on Linux e.g. /usr/games/steamcmd or ~/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh. You can also enter the folder containing steamcmd — the file name is appended on save. Command generation, local scanning and download-folder inference for new profiles all rely on it.
一行一条，可存多个账号的登录命令（例：login 你的用户名）。第一行 = 批量: One command per line; you can store several accounts' login commands (e.g. login your_username). The first line is sent automatically before a batch download; the others are picked from the 「发送登录命令」dropdown in the steamcmd terminal. The first login needs the password and email code typed inside steamcmd; once cached on this machine, only this command is needed to await verification. Passwords written into the command are stored in plain text in the local settings file — keep it safe. The account must own the game, or downloading its Workshop content fails.
Steam 客户端存放游戏内容库的位置（如 D:\\SteamLibrary），: Where the Steam client keeps its game libraries (e.g. D:\SteamLibrary). The「纳入已有 mod」wizard reads the client's subscription records from it; you can pick the library root, the steamapps folder or the workshop folder. It only concerns the Steam client and has nothing to do with steamcmd's folders.
批量查询 Steam 工坊接口时，两次请求之间的等待时间；太小可能被服务器限流: Wait time between two requests when querying the Steam Workshop API in bulk; too small may trigger rate limiting.
请求被服务器限流（429/503）时的自动重试上限，每次重试间隔会逐渐拉长: Automatic retry limit when the server rate-limits (429/503); the interval grows with each retry.
距上次已知更新超过这个天数的 mod，在更新检测结果里标红提示（作者更新节奏慢，: Mods whose last known update is older than this many days are flagged red in update-check results (slow authors are worth watching).
每个 mod 保留的历史版本记录条数；检测到新版本时自动淘汰更旧的记录。修改后重: Historical version records kept per mod; older records are dropped when a new version is detected. Takes effect after restarting the program (the count is read once at startup).
整体字号缩放百分比，100 = 默认（建议 80~200，超出范围不生效）。改后: Overall font scale percentage, 100 = default (80~200 recommended; out-of-range values are ignored). Takes effect after restarting the program (the scale is applied once at startup).
每个 mod 保留的备份份数；超出后自动淘汰最旧的备份（钉住的除外）: Backups kept per mod; the oldest (unpinned) ones are dropped beyond this.
全部备份合计的容量上限；超出后从最旧的备份开始清腾（钉住的除外）: Total capacity for all backups; beyond it the oldest (unpinned) backups are cleaned up.

开：批次开始前自动发送设置页里的登录命令（默认，维持原行为）；\n关：批次直接发:
On: send the login command from the settings page automatically before a batch (default, previous behavior);
Off: the batch goes straight to downloading — when switching accounts, turn it off, run login for the other account in the steamcmd terminal manually, then start the batch; if not logged in the batch waits at「需要登录」for you.
开：每批下载开始前自动清空 steamcmd 的下载缓存（depotcache: On: clear steamcmd's download cache (depotcache and workshop\downloads) before each batch — the cache can resurrect deleted mods into the download folder (a mod deleted by this tool comes back into the ledger on a later batch); clearing it cuts this off; it also helps with some「下载失败」. Cost: shared data in the cache is re-downloaded, costing traffic when reinstalling the same batch shortly. Default on (same default as RimSort).
开：每批下载结束后自动清空 steamcmd 的下载缓存（与批次前清理同一套引擎: On: clear steamcmd's download cache after each batch (same engine as the before-batch cleanup) — manifests/half-finished files from this batch don't pile up across batches (steamcmd also refreshes the cache manifests on login). Cost: a bit of traffic when reinstalling the same batch shortly. Default on.
开：程序退出前清一次 steamcmd 下载缓存（把本次会话登录刷新的manif: On: clear steamcmd's download cache once before the program exits (taking away manifests refreshed by this session's logins). Default off: deleting a big cache slows the exit by a few seconds, and the batch-end/after-clearing cleanup already covers the main occasions — turn it on when really needed.

mod 库里标题含这些词的条目，在【标题检测】页黄字提醒（离线、毫秒级）。逗号或: Mods whose titles contain these words are flagged yellow on the【标题检测】page (offline, millisecond-level). Separate with commas or semicolons (Chinese/English both, normalized on save; words may contain spaces, e.g. no longer — spaces are not separators); case-insensitive; empty = disabled. Default: abandoned, deprecated, discontinued, unmaintained, outdated, obsolete, unsupported, legacy, defunct, no longer, not maintained, not updated, no update, final version, last version, 停更, 弃坑, 断更, 烂尾, 停止更新, 不再更新, 不更新, 停止维护, 不再维护, 不再支持, 弃用, 过时 — map names like "Abandoned Mines" also match; it is a reminder, not a verdict — delete the word if it misreports.
远端健康检测时，远端标题含这些词的条目按「弃坑」红字提醒（标题不符 / bann: During remote health checks, remote titles containing these words are flagged red as「弃坑」(title-mismatch / banned signals are unaffected). Comma or semicolon separated (Chinese/English both, normalized on save; words may contain spaces), case-insensitive; empty = disabled. Default: abandoned, deprecated, discontinued, unmaintained, outdated, obsolete, unsupported, legacy, defunct, no longer, not maintained, not updated, no update, 不再维护, 不再更新, 停止更新, 停更, 弃坑, 断更, 烂尾, 停止维护, 不再支持 — deliberately fewer than the local list (final/last version style names misreport too often; rather miss than misreport).
马上清空一次 steamcmd 的下载缓存（depotcache 与 works:
Clear steamcmd's download cache once right now (depotcache and workshop\downloads), using the same engine as the automatic before-batch cleanup: content folders are never touched, and while steamcmd is running only unused parts are cleared (occupied ones are skipped, which is normal).
With a very large cache the UI may freeze for a few seconds (deletion runs on the main thread).
